title_ar: أفعال التقاضي والإبرام والمطالبات القانونية والتفاوضية

verbs.translation_en: to sue / to take legal action against

examples.de: Der Kläger verklagte den Konzern auf Zahlung von Schadensersatz.
examples.ar: قَاضَى الْمُدَّعِي الشَّرِكَةَ الْعِمْلَاقَةَ لِلْمُطَالَبَةِ بِدَفْعِ تَعْوِيضٍ عَنِ الضَّرَرِ.
examples.en: The plaintiff sued the corporation for payment of damages.

verbs.translation_en: to contest / to challenge / to appeal

examples.de: Die Anwälte fochten das erstinstanzliche Urteil fristgerecht an.
examples.ar: طَعَنَ الْمُحَامُونَ فِي حُكْمِ الْمَحْكَمَةِ الابْتِدَائِيَّةِ ضِمْنَ الْمُهْلَةِ الْقَانُونِيَّةِ.
examples.en: The lawyers contested the lower court's ruling within the statutory deadline.

verbs.translation_en: to negotiate / to hammer out

examples.de: Die Tarifparteien handelten einen zukunftsfähigen Tarifvertrag aus.
examples.ar: تَفَاوَضَ طَرَفَا النِّزَاعِ الْعُمَّالِيِّ عَلَى عَقْدِ عَمَلٍ جَمَاعِيٍّ مُسْتَدَامٍ.
examples.en: The collective bargaining partners negotiated a viable collective agreement.

verbs.translation_en: to enforce / to execute (a judgment)

examples.de: Der Gerichtsvollzieher vollstreckte den rechtskräftigen Titel.
examples.ar: نَفَّذَ مَأْمُورُ التَّنْفِيذِ الْقَضَائِيِّ السَّنَدَ التَّنْفِيذِيَّ الْحَائِزَ لِقُوَّةِ الشَّيْءِ الْمَقْضِيِّ بِهِ.
examples.en: The bailiff enforced the legally binding enforcement order.

verbs.translation_ar: يَتَنَازَلُ عَنْ / يُحِيلُ حَقًّا أَوْ مِلْكِيَّةً
verbs.translation_en: to cede / to assign (rights or claims)

examples.de: Der Gläubiger trat seine Forderungen an eine Factoring-Gesellschaft ab.
examples.ar: أَحَالَ الدَّائِنُ مُسْتَحَقَّاتِهِ الْمَالِيَّةَ إِلَى شَرِكَةِ تَحْصِيلِ دُيُونٍ.
examples.en: The creditor assigned his claims to a factoring company.

verbs.translation_en: to authorize / to empower / to grant power of attorney

examples.de: Die Geschäftsführung bevollmächtigte den Justiziar zur Unterzeichnung.
examples.ar: فَوَّضَتِ الإِدَارَةُ التَّنْفِيذِيَّةُ الْمُسْتَشَارَ الْقَانُونِيَّ بِالتَّوْقِيعِ.
examples.en: The management authorized corporate legal counsel to sign.

verbs.translation_en: to notarize / to authenticate formally

examples.de: Der Notar beurkundete den Grundstückskaufvertrag im Beisein beider Parteien.
examples.ar: وَثَّقَ كَاتِبُ الْعَدْلِ عَقْدَ شِرَاءِ الْعَقَارِ بِحُضُورِ الطَّرَفَيْنِ.
examples.en: The notary authenticated the real estate sales agreement in the presence of both parties.

verbs.translation_en: to consent / to agree formally

examples.de: Der Patient willigte nach sorgfältiger Aufklärung in den Eingriff ein.
examples.ar: وَافَقَ الْمَرِيضُ عَلَى التَّدَخُّلِ الْجِرَاحِيِّ بَعْدَ إِحَاطَتِهِ بِكَافَّةِ التَّفَاصِيلِ.
examples.en: The patient consented to the intervention after thorough explanation.

verbs.translation_en: to prohibit / to stop / to prevent legally

examples.de: Das Gericht unterband per einstweiliger Verfügung den weiteren Vertrieb.
examples.ar: حَظَرَتِ الْمَحْكَمَةُ بِمُوجِبِ أَمْرٍ وَقْتِيٍّ اسْتِمْرَارَ عَمَلِيَّاتِ التَّوْزِيعِ.
examples.en: The court prohibited further distribution via an interim injunction.

verbs.translation_en: to regulate / to subject to rules

examples.de: Der Gesetzgeber reglementiert den Zugang zu sensiblen Technologien streng.
examples.ar: يُقَنِّنُ الْمُشَرِّعُ الْوُصُولَ إِلَى التِّقْنِيَّاتِ الْحَسَّاسَةِ بِصَرَامَةٍ.
examples.en: The legislature strictly regulates access to sensitive technologies.

verbs.translation_en: to submit / to lodge / to file

examples.de: Die Kanzlei reichte die Klageschrift fristgemäß beim Landgericht ein.
examples.ar: أَوْدَعَتْ شَرِكَةُ الْمُحَامَاةِ صَحِيفَةَ الدَّعْوَى لَدَى الْمَحْكَمَةِ الابْتِدَائِيَّةِ فِي الْمَوْعِدِ الْمُحَدَّدِ.
examples.en: The law firm submitted the statement of claim to the regional court on time.

verbs.translation_ar: يَسْتَصْدِرُ قَرَارًا أَوْ حُكْمًا بَعْدَ مُطَالَبَةٍ
verbs.translation_en: to obtain / to secure (an injunction or court order)

examples.de: Die Kläger erwirkten einen sofortigen Baustopp.
examples.ar: اسْتَصْدَرَ الْمُدَّعُونَ أَمْرًا قَضَائِيًّا بِالْوَقْفِ الْفَوْرِيِّ لِأَعْمَالِ الْبِنَاءِ.
examples.en: The plaintiffs obtained an immediate injunction halting construction.

verbs.translation_en: to ratify (a treaty or convention)

examples.de: Das Parlament ratifizierte das multilaterale Handelsabkommen mit großer Mehrheit.
examples.ar: صَادَقَ الْبَرْلَمَانُ عَلَى الاتِّفَاقِيَّةِ التِّجَارِيَّةِ مُتَعَدِّدَةِ الأَطْرَافِ بِأَغْلَبِيَّةٍ سَاحِقَةٍ.
examples.en: Parliament ratified the multilateral trade agreement by a large majority.

verbs.translation_ar: يُسَوِّي نِزَاعًا وِدِّيًّا / يُوَفِّقُ بَيْنَ الْخُصُومِ
verbs.translation_en: to mediate / to conciliate / to arbitrate

examples.de: Ein neutraler Mediator half, den langwierigen Rechtsstreit zu schlichten.
examples.ar: سَاعَدَ وَسِيطٌ مُحَايِدٌ فِي تَسْوِيَةِ النِّزَاعِ الْقَضَائِيِّ الطَّوِيلِ بِشَكْلٍ وِدِّيٍّ.
examples.en: A neutral mediator helped to settle the protracted legal dispute.

verbs.translation_en: to resolve / to settle (a conflict)

examples.de: Beide Parteien einigten sich darauf, die Auseinandersetzung außergerichtlich beizulegen.
examples.ar: اتَّفَقَ الطَّرَفَانِ عَلَى تَسْوِيَةِ الْخِلَافِ وَإِنْهَائِهِ خَارِجَ سَاحَاتِ الْقَضَاءِ.
examples.en: Both parties agreed to settle the dispute out of court.

verbs.translation_ar: يَفْرِضُ عُقُوبَةً أَوْ غَرَامَةً أَوْ حَظْرًا
verbs.translation_en: to impose / to inflict (sanctions or fines)

examples.de: Die Kartellbehörde verhängte empfindliche Bußgelder über die Beteiligten.
examples.ar: فَرَضَتْ هَيْئَةُ حِمَايَةِ الْمُنَافَسَةِ غَرَامَاتٍ مَالِيَّةً بَاهِظَةً عَلَى الْمُتَوَرِّطِينَ.
examples.en: The antitrust authority imposed heavy fines on the parties involved.

verbs.translation_en: to be liable / to be legally accountable
verbs.construction: haften für + Akk (mit dem Privatvermögen haften)

examples.de: Die Gesellschafter haften gesamtschuldnerisch für die Verbindlichkeiten.
examples.ar: يَتَحَمَّلُ الشُّرَكَاءُ الْمَسْؤُولِيَّةَ التَّضَامُنِيَّةَ عَنِ الالْتِزَامَاتِ الْمَالِيَّةِ.
examples.en: The partners are jointly and severally liable for the debts.

verbs.translation_en: to set forth / to explain / to plead

examples.de: Der Anwalt legte die Rechtsgründe in einem fundierten Schriftsatz dar.
examples.ar: عَرَضَ الْمُحَامِي الأَسَانِيدَ الْقَانُونِيَّةَ فِي مُذَكَّرَةٍ مُحْكَمَةِ التَّأْسِيسِ.
examples.en: The attorney set forth the legal grounds in a well-substantiated brief.

verbs.translation_en: to demand / to claim / to requisition

examples.de: Die Bürger fordern die konsequente Einhaltung der Verfassungsrechte ein.
examples.ar: يُطَالِبُ الْمُواطِنُونَ بِالِالْتِزَامِ الصَّارِمِ بِالْحُقُوقِ الدُّسْتُورِيَّةِ.
examples.en: Citizens demand strict adherence to constitutional rights.

verbs.translation_en: to decree / to order / to rule

examples.de: Die Aufsichtsbehörde verfügte die sofortige Stilllegung der defekten Anlage.
examples.ar: أَمَرَتِ الْهَيْئَةُ الرَّقَابِيَّةُ بِالإِيقَافِ الْفَوْرِيِّ لِتَشْغِيلِ الْمُنْشَأَةِ الْمَعْطُوبَةِ.
examples.en: The regulatory authority ordered the immediate shutdown of the defective facility.
